import os
import json
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)


# ============== ROBUST DATA LOADER ==============
def load_json_robust(filepath):
    """Load JSON file handling multiple formats."""
    with open(filepath, "r") as f:
        content = f.read()

    # Strip whitespace
    content = content.strip()

    # Try as list of dicts (common format for many ML challenges)
    try:
        data = json.loads(content)
        if isinstance(data, list) and len(data) > 0 and isinstance(data[0], dict):
            return pd.DataFrame(data)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        pass

    # Try JSON Lines format
    try:
        return pd.read_json(filepath, lines=True)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Last resort: try reading line by line
    try:
        lines = content.split("\n")
        data = [json.loads(line) for line in lines if line.strip()]
        return pd.DataFrame(data)
    except:
        # Return what we can parse
        raise ValueError(f"Failed to parse JSON from {filepath}")


# ============== CONFIG ==============
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.json")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.json")
SAMPLE_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sampleSubmission.csv")
SUBMISSION_FILE = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# ============== LOAD DATA ==============
print("Loading data...")
try:
    train_df = load_json_robust(TRAIN_PATH)
    test_df = load_json_robust(TEST_PATH)
    sample_submission = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_PATH)
    print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
    print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error loading data: {e}")
    raise

# ============== FEATURE ENGINEERING ==============
target_col = "requester_received_pizza"
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col != target_col]


# Helper to join list columns
def join_list_values(x):
    if isinstance(x, list):
        return " ".join(x)
    return ""


# Process subreddits list column
if "requester_subreddits_at_request" in train_df.columns:
    train_df["subreddits_text"] = train_df["requester_subreddits_at_request"].apply(
        join_list_values
    )
    test_df["subreddits_text"] = test_df["requester_subreddits_at_request"].apply(
        join_list_values
    )
else:
    train_df["subreddits_text"] = ""
    test_df["subreddits_text"] = ""

# Define text features (combine request text and title)
text_content_train = (
    train_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
    + " "
    + train_df["request_title"].fillna("")
)
text_content_test = (
    test_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
    + " "
    + test_df["request_title"].fillna("")
)

# Add giver_username_if_known as a separate binary feature (PROVEN IMPROVEMENT)
# This is a strong signal - if someone is mentioned as giving, request was successful
if "giver_username_if_known" in train_df.columns:
    train_df["giver_known"] = train_df["giver_username_if_known"].apply(
        lambda x: 1 if x != "N/A" and pd.notna(x) else 0
    )
    test_df["giver_known"] = test_df["giver_username_if_known"].apply(
        lambda x: 1 if x != "N/A" and pd.notna(x) else 0
    )

# Define numerical features
final_num_features = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
]

# Add giver_known if present
if "giver_known" in train_df.columns:
    final_num_features.append("giver_known")

X_num_train = train_df[final_num_features].copy()
X_num_test = test_df[final_num_features].copy()

# Fill missing numerical values
X_num_train = X_num_train.fillna(X_num_train.median())
X_num_test = X_num_test.fillna(X_num_train.median())

# TF-IDF vectorizer for text
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000, stop_words="english", ngram_range=(1, 1), min_df=2
)

X_text_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(text_content_train)
X_text_test = vectorizer.transform(text_content_test)

# Combine numerical and text features
X_train = np.hstack([X_num_train, X_text_train.toarray()])
X_test = np.hstack([X_num_test, X_text_test.toarray()])
y_train = train_df[target_col].values

# ============== TRAIN/VAL SPLIT WITH STRATIFICATION ==============
print("Splitting data for validation...")
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# ============== TRAIN LIGHTGBM MODEL ==============
print("Training LightGBM...")
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

model = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# ============== EVALUATE ON VALIDATION SET ==============
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
y_pred_proba_val = model.predict(X_val)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_pred_proba_val)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# ============== PREDICT ON TEST SET ==============
print("Predicting on test set...")
y_pred_proba_test = model.predict(X_test)

# ============== SAVE SUBMISSION ==============
# Ensure directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test_df["request_id"], "requester_received_pizza": y_pred_proba_test}
)

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_FILE}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Column names: {list(submission_df.columns)}")
